こんにちは～(^^)

お返事遅くなってごめんなさい。私のスーザンというキャラクターに興味を持ってくださり、温かいお言葉を本当にありがとうございます(^^)

あなたの絵はとても素敵です！

ぜひ、彼女のイラストを描いていただきたいです。

彼女の参考資料です：

drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EcgqOzpBVWfZBz7l3nzj_748-4nrUtXt?usp=sharing

あなたがそれらを有用と思う場合に備えて、いくつかの古い依頼も：

drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rWWKOnTSMzfeaoTTIYQtn2nL2ZSAizdH?usp=sharing

deviantart.com/jack31233/gallery/71289501/susan-grace

彼女のポーズ、衣装、表情、背景はお任せします。

長々と読んでいただきありがとうございました。
こんにちは！私はあなたの魅力を見て、私はあなたが私のOCを描くことができれば大好きです。ここにいくつかの参考資料があります https://imgur.com/a/ALjkqjY 自由に彼女を描いてください！興味を持ってくれてありがとう。

私のVtuberキャラ、アエロニカを描きたい！というアピール、ありがとうございます。
ぜひ、お好きなポーズ、お好きな服装で描いてください!
https://imgur.com/a/znkq86H

こんにちは
一緒に仕事をしたいです！特に色使いが好きです。

 私は新しいサマールックを持っていて、あなたのスタイルにそれを適用するのが大好きです。私はあなたがNSFWの何かに挑戦するのを見たいと思っています。あとはあなたに決めてもらえたら嬉しいです。

彼女の参考文献はこちらです。

https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/98705344

あなたの絵はとてもかわいいです。私のOCを描いてください。パーカーを着た白猫を抱いている姿も描いてみてください。

https://twitter.com/starra202/status/1533413744100839426

Hi there! Your art is so cuuute!

Would you draw my character? She’s very cute and tends to be sleepy, and she loves sweets🍬

Pose example:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/16TL0s4HpUk3IoZ4iMXHRmm_wq0dDvDMI/view?usp=drivesdk

Please don’t forget the sprinkles in her hair and have her wings pointed down so they don’t cut off! Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1dHpOvcEgNTx8CHfHQ55et5vod33llOMN/view?usp=drivesdk

Hi, I love your style!
I'd like to get an illustration for my VTuber model - her name is Fawna.
You're free to pose her as you wish! I would like to use the image for profile pictures and banners.  If I can have one with a background and one with no background, that would be amazing!
Thank you in advance!

Here are her references:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1e3yudYxISb7wJYR3HkpOMNPwkbtAOqUU?usp=sharing

Thanks for the appeal!
I, Ebina Seiren, would like to ask for your help.
You can wear any clothes you like as long as you don't forget your sun and moon hair ornaments and flipper ears.
Please look cute.

https://twitter.com/EbinaSeiren
https://twitter.com/EbinaSeiren/status/1402995959039074334
https://twitter.com/zounidaisuki/status/1293526374771093509
https://twitter.com/EbinaSeiren/status/1358649974716682240
https://twitter.com/EbinaSeiren/status/1355196098814431237

Once again, my name is Minato Ragi and I am a VTuber on YouTube.
Thank you for your appeal to skeb!
Thank you again for your time!

I'm requesting you to illustrate me as a Vtuber!
As for the composition, I would like to leave it up to you, and would appreciate it if you could draw it freely.

Intended use
We would be happy to use your illustration as a thumbnail for our Youtube stream and on various social networking sites.

● Format
We would like to use them as thumbnails, etc.
If possible, it would be helpful if you could also deliver separate data for the background and characters (transparent background).
PSD data would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you very much for your cooperation.

----------

minato ragi)
Twitter : https://twitter.com/minato_ragi
YouTube : https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC68G7CKwETqspxyNeMb7FiA

Age: 20s
Height: about 160cm
Gender: Female
Appearance: Elf ears, teardrops, and a marimo cocoon
Physique: slender
Personality: Calm.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1tDIAnWikV0AcyWAA9x2Gcf0mBNgiOsqu

Hello! I adore the fresh and fun feeling of your art--I was hoping to request a piece of my character!

They study marine biology, so their ahoge is meant to resemble a shark's fin wwww. They always have that dopey smile on their face. A very carefree type of person that doesn't seem all there. Any outfit is fine! Please draw them to your preference. Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1P4CxsxxtrSoRZ593aXV6U4_FBwdumtpt?usp=sharing

Hello! Thank you for the appeal! Your style is very cute and would be very happy if you drew her! Ill leave her pose, expression and background up to you! Please have fun drawing her ^^

http://puu.sh/IOZyR/deed44fbd4.png

Hi Nyapi, nice to meet you. This time I would like to ask for a real life size of Kaguya from the Power Pro application. (↓Reference)
https://twitter.com/megumin_pwpr/status/1502539893146279945?s=20&t=1DAKOhbqAOjEiJjixLWBkA
I will leave the poses, etc. to you. Thank you in advance.

Hello! I received your appeal. Your art is super, super cute!
Sorry to cancel and resend, but the translation option was disabled by accident...

Here are some references:
https://imgur.com/a/Q6Xrfab
https://imgur.com/a/7YbwvbQ

Please feel free to draw any kind of outfit you think is best!

Hello, your art is very pretty! If it is okay with you, I would like to ask for a drawing of my character. I would like two differences in expression. The second picture's difference also has a hand on the head.

Picture 1: She is strongly wishing for a headpat.
Picture 2: She has an expression of relief. This is because her head is being patted.
There are references for the expressions and poses in the URL.

Please note the heart-shaped highlight underneath the eye pupil.

Usage: Twitter, Twitch, YouTube

Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aeS3UyaZ3SdHpeazurw6Pl7Sl52vla6j?usp=sharing

Thanks for the request I would love if you could draw my character. They are a cat girl swordsman who is often calm but easily excited. Please draw them however you'd like, thanks!

https://imgur.com/a/Off7K47

Thanks for the appeal! 🍊
I'd love to have you draw our boy, and I request it!

I'll leave it all up to you, and I hope you'll draw the poses, expressions, etc. as you feel like it!
It would be helpful if you could put the address on a separate layer.

Thank you for your consideration!

References
https://twitter.com/sekki07/status/1332543373299761157
https://hub.vroid.com/characters/3007739613797866669

Hello! I like your work! I want to request a drawing of my character, she is an artificial intelligence, she looks tired but is still full with energy! A lot of cubes are floating around her to make it appear more digital. The pose is up to you.

References: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1L93ZH510GMQJGlvEnHLdIkxT0YNq_PfQ?usp=sharing

I want to use it for my twitch, youtube and twitter.
Thank you for your time!

Hello! Your artwork is so cute!

Could you please draw my character?
She is a short black lucky cat and has a tsundere-like personality.

Please draw her making a heart with her fingers, similar to the reference photo.

You can change the facial expression if you'd like.
You can also choose if she keeps her jacket on.
If the jacket is on, please cover part of her hands with the sleeves.

Thank you so much!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dap-w9y6l-QLHarLbxmbQKoFio9-wgfB?usp=sharing

Hello! I Found your art really appealing and overall very pretty. Could you please draw my character without the bandana/face covering and make him with a confident/menacing smile(kind of like Gilgamesh from fate: https://images.alphacoders.com/945/945556.png) and if you could have my character in a kimono(it doesn't matter what colour, you can decide) 

here is my character https://imgur.com/a/ZmHtyBe

Hope you are well and I wish you good fortune!.

https://imgur.com/a/ZmHtyBe

Hello there again. I really liked your work and I was hoping if you can draw my character again in your style but she has a different outfit. Again posing is your choice. Thank you for your consideration of my request ^^

https://imgur.com/a/CcWlSjY

Hello there, 

Can you draw my character in your art style? Posing is your choice and you can use the props that she has.

Looking forward to your work ^^

https://imgur.com/a/aMZKik7

素敵だったのでよろしければOCのるいくんを描いて頂けないでしょうか。

②レイヤー別に黄色と青い目を作っていただけますでしょうか。
③背景透過のレイヤーまたはpngも頂けますと幸いでございます。

お忙しい中大変恐縮ですが、ご検討のほどよろしくお願いいたします！
